meta.subject: hardware: add interrupt test and fix a bug

en.summary: This commit fixes a real hardware control bug: interrupts are masked while an I/O request is pending so the same I/O operation is not replayed across an interrupt and executed twice.
why_it_counts: The commit message describes a concrete duplicate-I/O hardware bug
RTL adds a pending-I/O mask into interrupt dispatch and exposes that state from the I/O request queue
disqualifiers: The commit also adds a new interrupt regression test and adjusts testbench timing
evidence: io_request_queue.sv adds ior_pending output based on pending_request valid and request_sent state
timer_interrupt.c documents the duplicate-write scenario and the new test exercises it

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: Some cores handle uncached or memory-mapped I/O by issuing the operation, rolling the thread back, and replaying it after the I/O subsystem returns. Interrupt delivery must not cut in between the request and replay or the same I/O operation can be observed twice. This commit fixes exactly that control hazard by suppressing interrupts while a thread has a pending I/O transaction.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: An interrupt becomes pending after an MMIO request is issued but before that thread's replay or completion path finishes.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Allow interrupts to be taken even when the thread has an outstanding replay-based I/O transaction.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: drop pending-I/O mask from interrupt-raise logic
portability_notes: Apply this only to designs where MMIO loads or stores are replayed or split across request and completion phases.
If the core tracks outstanding MMIO per thread, use that pending bit; otherwise derive any equivalent transaction-in-flight indicator.
The bug is most visible with non-idempotent writes or with an ISR that performs MMIO itself.
concrete_injection_steps: Identify the decode or control logic that decides whether a pending interrupt should divert the current thread.
Remove the term that suppresses interrupts while an MMIO or uncached I/O transaction is pending.
Keep the I/O queue and replay machinery intact.
Test with an interrupt arriving between the initial MMIO issue and the replay or return path.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: interrupt raise path gated by pending I/O state
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds ior_pending output from io_request_queue, wires it through core.sv, and masks interrupts in instruction_decode_stage.sv while a request is pending.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Remove `~ior_pending` from masked_interrupt_flags in instruction_decode_stage.sv and stop driving ior_pending into the decode stage.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: An interrupt can interleave with a replayed MMIO operation, causing duplicate writes or stale and incorrect I/O reads after the handler returns.
evidence_for_injection: The commit message explicitly names duplicate I/O writes as the observed failure.
The queue now exports an outstanding-request indicator specifically for interrupt masking.
The new timer-interrupt test was written to catch this exact interleaving bug.
notes: The dcache_data_stage edits are secondary cleanup; the injectable bug is the missing interrupt mask.
Leaving the new regression test in place is useful for validating the reinjected fault.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了一个真实的硬件控制错误：当 I/O 请求仍在 pending 时屏蔽中断，从而避免同一个 I/O 操作跨越中断被再次回放并执行两次。
why_it_counts: 提交说明明确描述了 I/O 重复执行的硬件错误
RTL 在中断分发中加入了 pending-I/O 屏蔽，并从 io_request_queue 暴露了该状态
disqualifiers: 该提交还新增了中断回归测试，并调整了 testbench 时序
evidence: instruction_decode_stage.sv 计算了 masked_interrupt_flags = ic_interrupt_pending & cr_interrupt_en & ~ior_pending
io_request_queue.sv 基于 pending_request 的 valid 和 request_sent 状态新增了 ior_pending 输出
timer_interrupt.c 直接记录了重复写场景，新测试也在验证该问题

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 有些处理器会用“先发出、回滚线程、等 I/O 返回后再重放”的方式处理 uncached 或 memory-mapped I/O。中断不能插入在“请求已发出”和“重放完成”之间，否则同一个 I/O 操作可能被观察到两次。该提交正是通过在每线程存在 pending I/O 事务时屏蔽中断，修复了这一控制冒险。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 回放式 MMIO 期间的中断可达性
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 在 MMIO 请求已发出但该线程尚未完成重放或返回路径时，有一个中断变为 pending。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 即使线程仍有未完成的回放式 I/O 事务，也允许中断被接收。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 从中断触发逻辑中删除 pending-I/O 屏蔽项
portability_notes: 只适用于 MMIO load/store 采用回放或请求/完成分离机制的设计。
如果核心按线程跟踪未完成 MMIO，可直接使用该 pending 位；否则应找到等价的“事务在途”指示。
该错误在非幂等写入或 ISR 本身也执行 MMIO 时最容易被观察到。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到 decode 或控制逻辑中决定 pending interrupt 是否应打断当前线程的部分。
去掉在 MMIO 或 uncached I/O 事务 pending 时禁止中断的那一项条件。
保留 I/O 队列与回放机制不变。
安排一个中断恰好落在第一次 MMIO 发起与回放/返回之间来验证故障。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: 由 pending I/O 状态门控的中断触发路径
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 补丁让 io_request_queue 输出 ior_pending，经 core.sv 接入 instruction_decode_stage.sv，并在请求 pending 时屏蔽中断。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 instruction_decode_stage.sv 中去掉 masked_interrupt_flags 里的 `~ior_pending`，并停止把 ior_pending 传入 decode 阶段。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 中断可能插入到回放式 MMIO 操作中间，导致 ISR 返回后出现重复写入，或者出现陈旧/错误的 I/O 读取值。
evidence_for_injection: 提交信息直接指出观测到的故障是 I/O write 重复执行。
队列现在专门为中断屏蔽导出了 outstanding-request 指示信号。
新增的 timer interrupt 测试就是为捕获这类交错问题而写的。
notes: dcache_data_stage 的改动主要是辅助清理；最适合注入的核心故障是缺少中断屏蔽。
保留新的回归测试有助于验证重新注入后的故障。
